Death on Tattered Wings: Deployment Phase Pick this unit if it has not been deployed. Set up this unit in reserve high above the battlefield. It has now been deployed.
Keywords: Deploy
Loathsome Descent: Your Movement Phase Pick this unit if it is high above the battlefield. Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Red Ruin: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Heal (X) this unit where X is an amount equal to the roll.

name: Revenant Draconith (Scourge of Aqshy)
abilities:
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.
Brimming with Rancour: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot end moves made as part of a non-Charge Move ability within X" of this unit, where X is equal to your current fury level.
Keywords: Rampage
Volatile Animus: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

Retaliatory Posture: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks, including attacks made with Companion weapons, that target an enemy unit that used a Fight ability this phase.

Unrelenting Ferocity: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks.
• Add 1 to the Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit's Companion melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has not used a Fight ability this phase.

name: Cursed Sepulchre
abilities:
Locus of Shyish: Each time a friendly Soulblight Gravelords Wizard casts a Summon Spell from the 'Manifestations of the Grave' lore, you can measure the range and visibility from this terrain feature instead.
Leeching Soil: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain while it is within 9" of this terrain feature, Heal (1) this terrain feature.

name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Soulblight Gravelords Hero
abilities:
Undead Minions: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit:
• This unit has Ward (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Dark Intrigue: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, you receive 1 command point.
Keywords: Spell
Immortal Retainers: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit Pick a friendly Deathrattle Cavalry or Infantry unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.
Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Grave Beast's Talons is 4.
Beast Form: Your Hero Phase Pick 1 of the following units to be this unit's beast form:
• A Dire Wolves unit with 1 model.
• A Fell Bats unit with 1 model.
Set up the beast form unit within 1" of this unit, then remove this unit from the battlefield. The Beast Form unit can use Move and Core abilities in your next movement phase.
If the beast form is destroyed, before it is removed from play, set up this unit on the battlefield once more within 1" of it.
In addition, in any combat phase before Fight abilities are used, or at the end of any turn, you can have the beast form unit transform back into this unit. If you do so, set up this unit within 1" of the beast form unit and remove the beast form unit from the battlefield.
This ability can only be used by an Infantry hero.
Acolyte of Necros: Each time this unit successfully casts a spell in your hero phase and the casting roll was an unmodified 10+, add 1 to this unit's power level until the start of your next turn
Fabled Heirlooms: When this unit is added to your Order of Battle, you can immediately give it 1 artefact of power
Picky Eater: This unit cannot be picked as a target for the 'The Hunger' ability unless your opponent's gneral has the Order keyword. This flaw can only be picked for a Vampire hero.
Fractured Mind: Start of Battle Round Roll a dice. On a 1-3, for the rest of the battle round, this unit cannot use commands and any heroic trait they have has no effect.
Repulsed by the Sacred: You cannot make ward rolls for this unit while it is within 12" of an enemy Priest or for damage inflicted on it by a Prayer ability.
Tenuous Grip on Undeath: End of Your Turn This unit must use this ability if no enemy models were slain by it this turn. Allocate 1 damage point to this unit (a ward roll cannot be made for that damage point).
Crushing Stomp: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a non-Monster enemy unit n combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Keywords: Rampage
Feed on Sorcery: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, ward rolls cannot be made for the target and add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Companion melee weapons.
Keywords: Rampage
Wails of the Damned: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
Become the Swarm: When this unit is destroyed, roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with it. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Undying Companion: This unit's Undying Companion is a token. This unit has Ward (5+) while its Undying Companion is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove its Undying Companion from the battlefield.
Master of Dark Magics: While this unit is not in combat, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

name: Blades of the Hollow King
abilities:
Solia, the Tutor: Any Combat Phase This unit can use this ability while its Cado Ezechiar is on the battlefield. Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
• This unit has Ward (5+)
• This unit's Ezechiarian Greatsword has Crit (Mortal)
Aurelias: Your Hero Phase This unit can use this ability while its Aurelias is on the battlefield. Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to this unit's power level.
• Each time a casting roll is made for this unit, you can re-roll 1 of the dice.
Retribution or Salvation: Your Hero Phase This unit can cast this spell while its Cado Ezechiar is on the battlefield. Pick a visible unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Deathrattle or Deadwalkers unit, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.
Keywords: Spell

name: Corpse Cart (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Unholy Lodestone: Your Hero Phase Pick a friendly Deadwalker Zombies unit within this unit's combat range to be the target. Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, its 'Mindless Ferocity' ability inflicts mortal damage on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+.
Necromantic Goad: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn Pick a friendly Deadwalker Zombies unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat.

name: Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia (Scourge of Ghyran)
abilities:
Irresistible Demand: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy Hero within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.
Keywords: Spell
Allow Me To Remind You...: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.
Lest You Forget...: Once Per Battle Round, Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell or Charge ability for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit Pick 1 dice from the charge roll or casting roll for that ability. Your opponent must re-roll that dice.
